name: Liminal Ape 7
summary: Enter the unsettling world of Liminal Ape 7, a liminal horror experience set in endless, maze-like backrooms where every corner hides danger. Explore vast, eerie corridors as you hunt for scattered gold, your only means of survival and progression. Armed with grenades, you can fend off threats, but beware—monsters are fast, loud, and relentless, hunting you through the shadows with terrifying speed.
